beats.event: On Outside assignment, joins Rob Hall's Adventure Consultants team
Trains and acclimatizes; ascends through the Everest camps
Departs Camp IV after midnight for the summit push
Bottlenecks at the Balcony and Hillary Step cost nearly two hours
Reaches the summit; already notes weather turning
Begins descent as snow starts falling and light fades
Blizzard intensifies to 70-knot gusts; visibility near zero
Becomes lost, wandering near Kangshung Face precipice
Waits through the night with stranded, dying climbers
Visibility clears near midnight; some reach Camp IV alive
Learns guide Rob Hall and others died on the mountain
Eight recorded deaths from a single summit day
Returns home; publishes Into Thin Air in 1997
